properties.label: Tsunami & storm-surge exposure — high
properties.description: Coastal land at or below 5 m elevation within 3 km of Manila Bay / the West Philippine Sea. Evacuate inland or to higher ground on a tsunami warning or strong ground shaking.

properties.label: Tsunami & storm-surge exposure — moderate
properties.description: Coastal land between 5 m and 10 m elevation within 3 km of the shoreline. Be ready to move to higher ground.

properties.label: Landslide susceptibility — high
properties.description: Steep terrain where at least 30% of the ground has slopes of 25° or more (ridges, ravines, river gorges). Watch for cracks, tilting trees and muddy springs during heavy rain.

properties.label: Landslide susceptibility — moderate
properties.description: Hilly terrain where at least 35% of the ground has slopes of 15° or more. Prolonged or heavy rainfall can trigger slope failure.
